results.title: The Lowdown’s creator has season 3 trouble planned—if FX says yes
results.description: Sterlin Harjo has a bigger conspiracy in mind, but FX hadn’t decided on season 3 by November 26, 2026.

results.title: 60-day Summer Fair from March 28
results.description: The Karnataka Exhibition Authority will organise a 60‑day Summer Fair from March 28, 2027. The authority has invited applications from interested persons for setting up small amusement units, snack and refreshment stalls, and handicraft sales outlets on a rental basis during the fair. Interested applicants can obtain application forms and submit them to the authority’s office on or before December 3. For further details, they can contact the authority’s office or its staff member Naveen Kumar…

results.title: Pigeon Forge's Mountain Mile Lights Its Tree Nov. 28; Christmas Market Starts Nov. 27
results.description: Pigeon Forge's Mountain Mile hosts its tree lighting Saturday and a Christmas Market with Santa, train rides and a Kid Zone through late December.
